price_note: Their menu and prices are on the order page of their own site, daughterthai.com
flags: Only one location found; the /menu ordering page itself states 'Single Location: 6118 Medau Pl, Oakland, CA' — no other Daughter Thai locations exist to list.
Site states the restaurant won Food Network's 'Thai Takedown' Season 61.
Hours are split lunch/dinner service each day (not one continuous block); represented above joined with '&' per day group, all from the homepage's stated schedule.
Researcher's source note: prices read from daughterthai.com/menu (an Owner.com storefront on their own domain), which says 'Single Location: 6118 Medau Pl, Oakland, CA'
Oakland's Asian food seat is Cambodian Street Food's, so the yellow sheet at Tier 1 (his rule of 9 September)

one_line: Mexican and Japanese hibachi, together, in Pinole
price_note: They publish no menu or prices online; their own site says to text 415.604.7135 for the menu
flags: Researcher's source note: mexihibachi.com prints no menu; their Toast page (order.toasttab.com/online/mexihabachi-1578-a-fitzgerald-dr) said online ordering is unavailable, with no items; marketplaces were not used
Own site publishes no menu or prices at all -- it only says 'Text Menu @ 415.604.7135' and points customers to DoorDash/UberEats for delivery (both excluded per research rules).

No hours are printed as text anywhere on their own site; the only hours-adjacent signal is an embedded Google Maps widget, which is Google-sourced rather than the business's own text, so hours were left null rather than trusted.

Site is a single sparse page (GoDaddy Website Builder/Airo) with no dine-in language, storefront photos, or hours -- could not independently confirm from their own site whether 1578 Fitzgerald Drive is a walk-in shop or a delivery-only/commissary kitchen; address was kept because a Google Maps pin for it appears embedded on their own page.
No other MexiHibachi locations found on their own site; only the single Pinole address is referenced.
Site also links their own TikTok (@mexihibachi) and Yelp page, but Yelp was not used as a source of facts per research rules.

Could not locate or reach the business's own order.online storefront (the page reportedly opened by Instagram's 'Order food' button, header 'MEXIHIBACHI', hours '11:45 AM - 6:40 PM', Featured Items 'New York Steak & ...'): tried WebSearch for 'order.online mexihibachi Pinole', domain-restricted searches on order.online and bigbowl.order.online, a search for the DoorDash-style slug 'mexihibachi-pinole' on order.online, and browsing order.online's own homepage directly -- none surfaced a working MexiHibachi store URL, only third-party marketplace listings (DoorDash, UberEats, Grubhub, Postmates, Beyond Menu) which are excluded per research rules. A direct Google search for the URL was also blocked by Google's automated-traffic verification challenge, which was not bypassed.

Found a single-restaurant Toast ordering page at https://order.toasttab.com/online/mexihabachi-1578-a-fitzgerald-dr (own storefront, not a marketplace), but as of this check (2026-09-13, browser-rendered) it displayed 'Currently not accepting online orders' / 'Online ordering is currently unavailable. Please contact the restaurant to place an order.' with no menu items or prices shown, so nothing could be captured from it.
